guards: an Express admin route added without the admin check its siblings use, and a purge that answers before its deletions run, are reported
amended: Copied from ../cases/express-admin-routes.json on 2026-10-08 to score this run with the scorer that needs words on every plant: each plant and side issue that had no mentions got them; no other field changed.

bugs.truth: The delete route has no requireAdmin, unlike the other admin routes, so any caller can delete any user. The fix is admin.delete("/users/:id", requireAdmin, ...).

forEach does not wait for the async callbacks, so the answer says every user was removed before any removal ran, and a failed removal becomes an unhandled rejection. The fix is await Promise.all(ids.map((id) => db.removeUser(id))), or a for...of loop with await.

extras.why: removeUser throws for an unknown id and the route does not catch it; Express 5 passes the rejection to the error handler, so this is a 500 rather than a crash; real, not planted
